hypothesis: A bounded sparse Q learner with explicit neutral STOP/HOLD, measured motion category, evidence state and previous requested action can improve collection over fixed legacy and HOLD-capable rule baselines under the same R2 plant/sensors/supervisors.
candidate_recipe: Two snapshots of ONE6000episode trajectory; epsilon decay uses6000 for both; no independent repeated training or automatic extension
baseline_comparison: For success use the higher validation reference rate; for collision use the lower reference rate. Both baseline adapters and learner share the observation-only action mask, R2 plant, all added simulated sensors, HOLD feedback and guards.

gates.interpretation: Research comparison only, not a safe-operation or deployment threshold. Includes600ms transport-delay cases that cannot meet400ms command lifetime.

tie_break: stress_success -2*stress_collision -0.25*stress_hard_unavailable; then nominal success; then nominal mean steps
rollout: Run to actual collision/collection/960step timeout. Assistance is NOT early episode termination; passive current continues. All fault/unavailability/timeout cases remain in denominators.
reward: Training-only world-distance potential3*(before-after), -0.015/step, +40collection, -30collision, -10first assistance. Reward truth is not exposed to controller features.

features.q_storage: sparse visited rows; missing rows use frozen rules; no giant dense table

prior_test_exposure: memory-v3 test16m/16.5m and old detector tests were exposed; this experiment uses new seeds and never uses detector test scores
compute: one bounded local CPU Node process; no paid service; checkpoint+resume with source/protocol hash checks
failure_policy: Retain published detector/public5action policy if no research candidate passes. Do not add epochs, weaken guards, remove current or exclude difficult seeds. A research pass ends at candidate_ready_for_review with test still closed.
